headline: Sensex and Nifty hold steady near 25,300 led by realty gains and strong Manappuram Finance Q2 results

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Strong buying in realty stocks which surged by 4% in recent sessions
Optimism over foreign investment flows into Indian financials and auto sectors
Robust quarterly earnings performance, specifically from Manappuram Finance
Significant wealth addition of ₹4.5 lakh crore in a single session's rally
whatHappening: The Nifty 50 index ended volatile sessions near the 25,300 mark
Manappuram Finance reported a three-fold jump in Q2 profit to ₹701 crore
Mahindra & Mahindra and IndiGo shares recorded gains of 5% and 4% respectively
NITI Aayog report indicates only 28% of PLI employment targets were met by FY26
summary: Indian markets showed resilience with Nifty holding above 25,250, driven by a rally in realty and banking sectors. Manappuram Finance posted strong quarterly results, while M&M and IndiGo saw significant gains. Investor sentiment remains positive amid foreign flow optimism and smallcap outperformance.
